query: select s.name as series, l.title as lesson_title, coalesce(length(l.content),0) as content_length, l.is_active, count(distinct e.id) as exercise_count, count(distinct eq.id) as exercise_question_count, count(distinct q.id) as quiz_count, count(distinct qq.id) as quiz_question_count, bool_and(coalesce(e.is_active,false) = false) filter (where e.id is not null) as exercises_inactive, bool_and(coalesce(e.is_published,false) = false) filter (where e.id is not null) as exercises_unpublished, bool_and(coalesce(q.is_active,false) = false) filter (where q.id is not null) as quizzes_inactive, bool_and(coalesce(q.is_published,false) = false) filter (where q.id is not null) as quizzes_unpublished from public.lessons l join public.chapters c on c.id=l.chapter_id join public.course_subject_offerings o on o.id=c.subject_offering_id join public.series s on s.id=o.series_id left join public.exercises e on e.lesson_id=l.id left join public.exercise_questions eq on eq.exercise_id=e.id left join public.quizzes q on q.lesson_id=l.id left join public.quiz_questions qq on qq.quiz_id=q.id where l.id in ('2261f542-9481-4d49-9a72-54b71fdb9929','f1ebf95d-9b61-40dc-b3a5-7a9699cac3be','221c3f88-b3cd-4287-9647-78f82e5928af','ac91de56-a15f-43ff-8baf-a2f4dcbe82b1','aec347c0-a680-4ef1-b4f6-67947a1e600c','50398ee8-8130-47eb-ad7c-f2ef9f8ad5d0') group by s.name,l.title,l.content,l.is_active order by s.name,l.title limit 6
